محمد بن عبد الله بن زرارة
عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن الأصم

notes: the second «وَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي» is a second isnad right after the first: its own group; the saying («قال حججت مع أبي عبد الله») follows the second isnad only, so the first route ends at al-Arjani without the Imam
the Imam speaks inside Ibn Bukayr's story («فقال يا ابن بكير»): last link (owner ruling 5)
«(رحمه الله)» and «(ع)» left out; «أبي» in both routes is a bare relation
